dialogue.radin.tutorial.sub: says Radin of the Side Rail
dialogue.radin.tutorial.1: Flameborn, hurry up, the Eternal Flame has called for an emergency!
dialogue.radin.tutorial.2: Let's see if you can handle some combat, go get some gear from that rack
dialogue.radin.tutorial.3: Go on, grab some gear from the rack so we can start
dialogue.radin.tutorial.4: Good, now try attacking that target dummy with your weapon's ability
dialogue.radin.tutorial.5: Remember to use your weapon ability on the target dummy to test it
dialogue.radin.tutorial.6: Ayeee. Good, good, you seem to know your way around a weapon.
dialogue.radin.tutorial.7: Ya know, I used to be the greatest warrior, but S'kellak sent me to guide the newbies! Heh...
dialogue.radin.tutorial.8: Aaanyway, go to the throne room, S'kellak is waiting on ya, the big tall one over there.
dialogue.skellak.tutorial.sub: says S'kellak, Creator of All Things
dialogue.skellak.tutorial.1: Flameborn, I need you to travel outside of Vaaz. Two kings who have fallen in the past have now been brought back to life in the form of undead demons.
dialogue.skellak.tutorial.2: I need you to investigate, and if needed, defeat them. I sense that this might be part of something bigger.
dialogue.skellak.tutorial.3: Use this stone if you ever need to get back here. I wish I could help you, but the Overworld is as unknown to me as it is to you.
dialogue.skellak.tutorial.4: You will be alone on this. I am sure your valor and strength will overcome anything you may encounter there.
dialogue.skellak.tutorial.5: This book will of good use too, it has been written by previous Flameborn who have traveled to those lands, it will be very useful to your survival.
dialogue.skellak.tutorial.6: I will also make sure to write any important things you may need to know. May luck be with you on this adventure, Flameborn.
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.1_deca: Greetings, Flameborn. Your information on the Decaying King has been useful.
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.1_lich: Greetings, Flameborn. Your information on the Night Lich has been useful.
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.1_both: Greetings, Flameborn. Your information on the fallen kings has been useful.
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.1_2: However, I do not bear good news. As I was suspecting, dark times are coming.
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.2_1: I, the Eternal Flame, am the eternal being of Creation, along with my siblings,
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.3_1: N'uk, my destructive sibling, has always wanted to take over all realms,
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.3_2: to destroy my creations, and turn all of reality into a devouring void.
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.4_1: The fallen kings were no coincidence. They were awakened by the force of his presence,
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.5_1: There is no time, Flameborn. You must come back and prevent the invasion from the Void.
dialogue.skellak.worrying_reunion.5_2: Use the book I have given you. I shall reward you once your task is done.
dialogue.skellak.molten_core.1_1: In recognition of your valor and dedication in defending against the Void's invasion,
dialogue.skellak.molten_core.1_2: I bestow upon you a fragment of my very own essence: the Molten Core.
dialogue.skellak.molten_core.2: Use it to forge a new kind of weapon, an Artifact. It will be your only chance to fight what's coming.
dialogue.skellak.molten_core.3: I can sense the darkness, champion. We must be ready soon.
dialogue.guard.finding: Of course. What are you looking for?
dialogue.guard.marked: There, marked it in your map.
dialogue.guard.unknown: Hm, I don't remember that, sorry.
dialogue.guard.option.ask_again: Let me ask about somewhere else
prominent.guard_directions.title: Guard's Directions
dialogue.ghaj.1: You are mine, feed me, empower me
dialogue.ghaj.2: You are nothing without me, you are weak
dialogue.ghaj.3: Kill them all, bring me a feast
dialogue.ghaj.5: How are you even still alive? You are so fragile without me...
dialogue.ghaj.7: Accept me into your mind, let me take control
dialogue.ghaj.8: We could do great things together, just let me in
dialogue.ghaj.9: Don't listen to him, listen to me, I am the only one who can save you
dialogue.gumas.1: You still think I can be slain? How foolish.
dialogue.gumas.2: You would have made a fine servant to the king... but your corpse will suffice.
dialogue.gumas.3_1: You believed you killed me once. Yet the King in Yellow called me back,
dialogue.gumas.3_2: stripped away my weakness, and forged me anew.
dialogue.gumas.4_1: And now... you will rise again,
dialogue.unholy_prison.1_4: It feels my hand upon its throat.
dialogue.unholy_prison.2_1: I have no need to deceive you.
dialogue.unholy_prison.2_5: all of it will be swallowed by the next great turning.
dialogue.unholy_prison.3_2: Endings are the doors through which greater things emerge.
dialogue.unholy_prison.3_3: Come to me, and I will make you more than mortal.
dialogue.unholy_prison.4_1: I would place the Yellow Sign within your soul
dialogue.unholy_prison.4_2: and unfasten you from the wheel of lesser life.
dialogue.unholy_prison.4_3: You would not serve the new era.
dialogue.unholy_prison.4_4: You would become a part of it.
dialogue.unholy_prison.4_5: A cog in something far greater than you could ever imagine.
dialogue.unholy_prison.5_2: Embrace what comes, and take your rightful place in the new era.
dialogue.skellak.assault.1_1: Flameborn! I am glad you are here. Hastur's forces are attacking the city.
dialogue.skellak.assault.1_2: We have sealed the entrances, and all dwarves and Serkonid have taken refuge.
dialogue.skellak.assault.2_1: The cultists have slain many of our people, they are destroying everything.
dialogue.skellak.assault.2_2: There is something within this room of great importance, something they must never reach. I will remain here and defend it.
dialogue.skellak.assault.2_3: In the meantime, purge the city of their forces, then come to the throne room.
dialogue.skellak.assault_end.1_1: I am glad you survived, Flameborn.
dialogue.skellak.assault_end.1_2: Even some of our own betrayed us, Dwarves, Serkonid,
dialogue.skellak.assault_end.1_3: other Flameborn turned from us and joined Hastur's forces.
dialogue.skellak.assault_end.2_2: The sorcerer Ama'gul destroyed our greatest weapon, the Primordial Forge.
dialogue.skellak.assault_end.2_3: It will take us hundreds of years to rebuild the city, and perhaps even longer to restore the Primordial Forge.
dialogue.skellak.assault_end.2_4: That was Hastur's true objective. He sought to steal time from us.
dialogue.skellak.assault_end.3_1: You must abandon the Overworld, it is no longer safe. Come to Vaaz and help us rebuild.
dialogue.skellak.assault_end.3_2: And when we are ready to strike back... we will.
dialogue.primordial_forge.skellak.1: Flameborn, it's been a while. The time has come.
dialogue.primordial_forge.skellak.2_1: Mirgaff has finished the preparations to start rebuilding the Primordial Forge.
dialogue.primordial_forge.skellak.2_2: The room is located below us, go find her.
dialogue.primordial_forge.meeting_mirgaf: Aye, Flameborn! Good to see ya, or meet ya, hard to tell these days.
Name's Mirgaff, master of the Primordial Forge.
This here is the first stage.
Eh it looks half-broken, but that's because you're lookin' at genius before it's finished.
Now, while I get this sorted, I need you to get something precious for the next stage.
Something rare. Something we haven't seen in these halls for an age.
Decades ago, another Flameborn brought one down from the Overworld.
Fine worker, that one. Dead now, so there's no askin' where they found it.
Word is, the precious item is in the clutches of a spider. A spider!
Aye, I know how that sounds, but I'm tellin' you true.
Go to that beast's lair and bring back what's mine. Without it, I cannot begin the next stage.
Please, Flameborn. Retrieve my precious piece. This work cannot continue without it.
dialogue.primordial_forge.mirgaff_prepar: Ohhh, ho ho ho! You actually found it! A full barrel of beer!
By the Forge, it's been decades since I've had a proper drink. Finest tool in all creation, that is.
Right then, let me finish things here.
Come back in a bit, and try not to tell anyone what the "essential component" was.
dialogue.primordial_forge.mirgaff_finish: Aaaand it's done! Well I now leave it up to ya, I'm just a builder!
dialogue.alm.hourglass.1_1: Hey, you, you're the one that needs that cursed hourglass right? Well you're in luck!
dialogue.alm.hourglass.2_1: The troops brought this from a cultist temple they've assaulted,
dialogue.alm.hourglass.2_2: it appears to contain some sort of infusion of unholy magic that we must destroy to weaken Hastur's influence.
dialogue.alm.hourglass.3_1: It's a very dangerous object, already tested by another group that well...
dialogue.alm.hourglass.3_2: well, failed, lost a few of our own for that, so S'kellak wanted to assign someone more competent for this task.
dialogue.alm.hourglass.4_1: From what we managed to learn, it creates an illusion of a future Hastur wants,
dialogue.alm.hourglass.4_2: we destroy that illusion and then we break apart that unholy influence.
dialogue.alm.hourglass.4_3: But keep in mind every time they will get stronger, and apparently so will the rewards, so there's that.
dialogue.alm.hourglass.5_1: Oh and about that, I am also in charge of rewarding you with cinders every time you defeat these illusions.
dialogue.alm.hourglass.5_2: And as you already know, I also have some stuff that might interest you,
dialogue.alm.hourglass.5_3: so visit me and my dog anytime you want. Wanna make a living somehow too.
dialogue.alm.hourglass.6_1: You know what, here, have this one on the house, since it's my job,
dialogue.alm.hourglass.6_2: but if you lose it you'll have to pay for another one, obviously, I'm not running a charity here.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.greet: Icewhisper! Where is my beautiful Icewhisper?! My heavy, sharp, perfect axe! Have you seen it?!
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.quest_acce: Yes! Good! Go ask the others! Don't come back empty-handed!
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.waiting: Then why are you standing here?! Go find it!
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.accept_que: Calm down, I'll go look for your axe.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.check_prog: I am still asking around about Icewhisper.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.crazy_text: Crazy? I was crazy once, they locked me in a room, a rubber room, a rubber room with rats, and rats make me crazy. Crazy? I was crazy once, they locked me in a room, a rubber room, a rubber room with rats, and rats make me crazy. Crazy? I was crazy once, they locked me in a room, a rubber room, a rubber room with rats, and rats make me crazy.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part2.gree: Greetings. What can I do for you today?
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part2.ask: Have you seen Bromo's axe anywhere? He's looking for it.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part2.rant: Ugh, please don't get me started on that guy. From sunrise to sunset, it's always complaining about that heavy piece of junk! I haven't seen it, and frankly, I'm glad it's gone. If only he'd stop whining about it all day!
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part2.fini: I will go ask someone else, thanks.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part2.leav: Never mind, I have to go.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part3.gree: Well, hello there. Do you need something?
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part3.ask: I am looking for Bromo's axe. Have you seen it?
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part3.spac: You mean that crazy guy? Listen, you cannot believe a word he says. The other day he was hallucinating, rambling on about taking that heavy axe of his and flying straight to space! The man has completely lost his mind.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part3.fini: Right... I think I will just keep asking around.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part4.gree: Hello there. What brings you around here?
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part4.ask: I have been asking around about Bromo's axe. Do you know where it is?
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part4.conf: Keep your voice down... Yes, I know where it is, because I took it and hid it. The man has become completely unstable, and it simply wasn't safe for him or anyone else to have that heavy weapon swinging around. I am not telling you where it is, and I am certainly not giving it back to him until his head is clear.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.part4.fini: I understand. I will go tell him I couldn't find it.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.conclusion: I asked around town, but no one has seen it. I think your axe is truly lost.
dialogue.prominent.bromos_axe.angry_mumb: Lost? Bah! Thieves and cowards, the lot of them... taking a man's weapon... *grumble*... useless... *mumble*...
